name: Mimamori College
description: Mimamori College — a theme for a caregiver training college for career-changers. A calm white ground with an inset documentary photograph that cross-fades between three practice-room scenes, a thin serif headline, and a strip of four small audience tiles biting the photo's lower edge; a blush notice band; one white sheet of five courses, each cell with its own coloured rule and round dot; a pale feather straddling a band seam above ruled figures; a white panel straddling the foot of the placement photograph. Fraunces for headings, Mulish for reading.
